name: korean-mail-mcp
description: Connects Naver, Daum and Kakao mailboxes to Claude through an MCP server: search, read, draft, send, move and trash mail over IMAP and SMTP. One server serves one account per service, and a service you leave empty is skipped

naver_address.title: Naver address
naver_address.description: Full Naver address, such as your_id@naver.com. Leave empty if you do not use Naver

naver_password.title: Naver IMAP password
naver_password.description: The Naver application password for IMAP and SMTP, not the account password. Leave empty if you do not use Naver

daum_address.title: Daum address
daum_address.description: Full Daum address, such as your_id@daum.net or your_id@hanmail.net. Leave empty if you do not use Daum

daum_password.title: Daum IMAP password
daum_password.description: The password Daum shows on its IMAP settings page, not the account password. Leave empty if you do not use Daum

kakao_address.title: Kakao address
kakao_address.description: Full Kakao address, such as your_id@kakao.com. Leave empty if you do not use Kakao

kakao_password.title: Kakao IMAP password
kakao_password.description: The password Kakao shows on its IMAP settings page, not the account password. Leave empty if you do not use Kakao

mail_full_name.title: Display name
mail_full_name.description: Name shown as the sender of mail you send, for every account. Leave empty to send with the address alone
